name: Balanced Spherical Grid
definition: A discretized angular and radial grid structure used to represent radiance fields for egocentric view synthesis, consisting of two grids (Yin and Yang) to handle spherical parameterization.
summary: The Balanced Spherical Grid is a dense spatial indexing structure for egocentric view synthesis that uses two complementary spherical grids with exponential radial scaling to maintain uniform cell aspect ratios and efficient hierarchical sampling.
